_: Bildkonzepte für die Rundgang-Illustrationen. Kuratiert, nicht erzeugt: ein Modell, das den Prompt bei jedem Lauf neu formuliert, ist die Ursache von Stildrift. Der Workflow walkthrough-illustrationen.json setzt stil + szene zusammen und ändert nichts daran. Bildparität mit walkthroughPanels.ts prüft walkthrough.test.ts. Der Stil ist in medium/welt/rest geteilt, damit ein Wechsel des Looks eine Zeile ist und nicht ein neuer Text.
format: quadratisch, native Aufloesung des Modells (~1254 px), gespeichert als WebP q88 — gemessen ein Viertel der Groesse eines 640-px-PNG bei doppelter Kante
medium: Hand-painted illustration, soft outlines, warm earthy colours, visible brush texture.
welt: The setting is a clean high-tech workbench: brushed steel, glass, machined modular parts, precision tools and thin amber indicator light. No wood grain, no brass, no leather, no paper stacks, no vintage props.
stil: A single meerkat, always the same character: slim, standing upright, three-quarter view at mid-shot distance, sandy fur with a darker mask around the eyes. Its equipment is modern: a slim matte charcoal technical harness with utility loops and a thin amber indicator strip, and a compact head-mounted inspection visor pushed up on its forehead — no apron, no leather, no rustic clothing. The meerkat is the operator — it observes, it decides, it hands work on; it never becomes the machine itself. Square composition with calm empty space. The meerkat's pose, body angle, distance and side of the frame change from scene to scene — sometimes crouching, sometimes reaching up, sometimes seen from behind over its shoulder, sometimes close and sometimes further away. It must always be recognisably the same individual, but never repeat the same stance. Soft light from the upper left, one warm amber accent on the single element that matters. The background is a fully OPAQUE flat colour #1b1714 filling the entire frame edge to edge — no transparency, no vignette, no frame, no border, no ground line, no horizon. Absolutely no text, no letters, no digits, no logos and no watermark anywhere in the image. The scene:

szenen.intro: On a wide bench lie only three different basic module shapes, a small pile of each. Above the bench, many different assemblies built from exactly those three shapes stand arranged in a loose grid, each one clearly a different combination. The meerkat stands further back on the right, one arm raised towards the assemblies, looking at them rather than at the viewer. One single assembly glows amber. No cabinets, no server racks, no screens.
szenen.mix: A line of identical machined modules glides past on a slim rail. The meerkat lets almost all of them run by untouched and lifts exactly one out, holding it under a small inspection lens. The lifted module glows amber; all the others stay plain metal. The meerkat leans in close over the rail, head lowered towards the lens, elbows resting on the bench.
szenen.trace: The meerkat watches a row of modules travel away to the right along a rail. Behind it a projected light strip shows the very same modules already laid out in the same order. The meerkat stands tall and turned mostly away from the viewer, looking down the length of the bench, tail curved behind it.
szenen.notice: A single amber spark has drifted up off the bench and is about to leave the frame at the top. The meerkat stretches upward on its toes, arm fully extended, and closes a small glass capsule around it just in time. On a rack behind it stand several capsules, each with a spark already resting quietly inside. Nothing is being poured.
szenen.wait: A module stands halted on a rail that continues straight out of the frame. A soft amber standby ring glows around it. The meerkat sits on the bench beside it, seen from behind over its shoulder, completely unhurried, one paw resting on the module. The background behind everything stays perfectly flat and even, with no glow, no gradient and no cast shadow.
szenen.verdict: The meerkat presses an amber seal onto a thin glass plate clamped in a slim metal frame. Beside the frame a circular indicator has already run most of the way round.
szenen.refill: A slim upright frame holds a row of glass tiles. A fresh, brightly glowing amber tile slides into the frame from the top while one dull, faded tile slips out of the bottom slot into a shallow tray. The meerkat crouches beside the tray, resting on its haunches, watching the faded tile arrive. No cartridges, no ammunition, no cylindrical rounds of any kind.
szenen.swap: The rail keeps running while the meerkat pulls one module out of its socket and holds a second, differently coloured module ready in the other paw. Two further modules of the same shape rest on the bench. The meerkat is half turned, weight on its back leg, one arm stretched out to the socket and the other held close to its chest.
szenen.blocks: The meerkat assembles machined modular units on the bench. One larger unit stands open, and inside it sits a smaller arrangement of the very same units. The meerkat kneels low at the bench, both paws on the open unit, head tilted to look inside it.
szenen.closing: Eight small illuminated panels stand in two rows on the bench, each showing a different simple abstract shape. The meerkat has stepped back to the left edge and looks at them from the side, arms lowered. The background behind everything stays perfectly flat and even, with no glow, no gradient and no cast shadow.
